name: MCPGateway
description: Unified MCP gateway: configured MCP servers behind one HTTP URI.

tools.name: add_server
tools.description:
Add an MCP server to the pool.

        Args:
            config: Server config — name, type ("http"|"stdio"), and
                command (stdio) or uri (http); optional env, description,
                mount_prefix.
            persist: Save to mcp.json.
            auto_start: Also start it when the gateway boots.

tools.name: export_migration_environment
tools.description:
Owner-only migration handoff from this gateway's stdio launch env.

        servers maps names to extra inherited variables to capture. Declared
        env fields are always included. Returns a private local file path only;
        no processes are started and no Agent data is admitted for migration.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description:
One MCP server's status and connection info.

        Args:
            name: The server name from the pool config.

tools.name: get_uri
tools.description: The unified gateway's HTTP URI (every mounted server, prefixed).

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: List the gateway's MCP servers and their status.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description:
List all available tools in this toolset (for LLM consumption)

        This method is used by ToolsetProxy to discover available tools.
        Uses funcdesc for unified type extraction (same as local tools).
        Named to match MCP's list_tools convention.

        Note:
            - Parses the original function signature (before @tool wrapping)
            - Does NOT include session_id parameter (transparent to LLM)
            - session_id is automatically injected by the framework

        Returns:
            dict: {
                "success": True,
                "tools": [
                    {
                        "name": "method_name",
                        "doc": "Method docstring",
                        "inputs": [
                            {
                                "name": "param_name",
                                "type": {"type": "str"} or {"type": "list", "args": [...]},
                                "default": value,
                                "doc": ""
                            }
                        ]
                    },
                    ...
                ]
            }

tools.name: remove_server
tools.description:
Remove an MCP server from the pool.

        Args:
            name: The server to remove.
            persist: Also drop it from mcp.json.

tools.name: restart_server
tools.description:
Restart one MCP server.

        Args:
            name: The server name from the pool config.

tools.name: start_servers
tools.description:
Start (mount) MCP servers by name.

        Args:
            names: Server names from the pool config.

tools.name: stop_servers
tools.description:
Stop (unmount) MCP servers by name.

        Args:
            names: Server names to stop.

tools.name: export_migration_tools
tools.description:
Capture observed tool contracts for ordinary App dependency packages.

        Provider names retain the old Agent's selection (mcp for the unified
        catalog, or a server name for prefix filtering). This exports metadata,
        not credentials, commands, deployment authority or import admission.

tools.name: export_migration_configuration
tools.description:
Privately capture effective MCP launch coordinates, environment and tool views.

        servers maps selected names to extra inherited environment fields;
        providers selects the original Agent's visible catalogs. Returns only
        the owner-private capture path. No migration or deployment is performed.

notes: was the endpoint's mcp_manager; spawns stdio servers, hence proc
